cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.

mechanism: A confidently leads a rota decision but changes endorsement format to retain B cooperation while insisting the support be visible to likely challengers.
confusable: Unlike general reassurance, A needs attributable support others can see; borrowed authority yields how it is delivered while preserving protective visibility.
comparison: Staff-meeting endorsement and email audience differ from a neighbor extension signature and identity key.
seedUse: Use D52-a microphone/private approval/email/copy chain with S02-b adapting the medium to the supporter.
